SMB-PRESS-GEOMETRY (lead decision): FontMatrix/FontBBox-aware Type3 boxes and WMode-aware vertical advance; until then any Type3 or vertical text on a page refuses (Refuse) or leaves the region incomplete (ReportAndContinue), which blocks redaction of e.g. pdfTeX PK-font pages.

A stream that nothing references as content (no page, page object, appearance, Do or content role) and that does not tokenize is not walked; its bytes are scanned in every spelling (as any payload).
